findings.claim: Immediate selection evidence and descendant survival credit disagree in strength and multiplicity status: the compressed-choice excess fixed-RMS advantage is small but batch-consistent (whole-window mean ~0.081 A, CI95 ~[0.070,0.092]), while the strongest survival enrichment (landmark_00_soft_mass, effect_z ~0.37, positive_batch_fraction ~0.86) does not survive joint BH correction (q ~0.12). Direction priorities should therefore weight the selection-side geometric contrast over the survival-side soft-mass signal.

The actual later-label calculation is terminal-credit mining over parent-debiased moment strata with terminal score time 0.99 and state time 1.0, i.e. last-record joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity. Ancestral coverage is thin: 349 of 700 batch nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6, so survival credit is dominated by shallow-lineage nodes and cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Survivor bias is present and material: only 14 independent batches with complete survival are available, teachers_per_batch_max is 2, and the survival tests are BH-adjusted jointly over 400 field/measure tests. The apparent landmark_00_soft_mass enrichment is therefore a survivor-conditioned association, not an unbiased affinity effect.

The unavailable comparison is the decoded terminal-label contrast: no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied, so last-record survival credit cannot be equated with final predicted affinity benefit. The selection-vs-survival disagreement is reported as a direction-priority input only, with the affinity comparison left unavailable.

Marginal local descriptors at landmark_00 are individually weak and inconsistent: local_dx, local_dy, local_dz have near-zero effect_z with positive_batch_fraction near 0.36-0.43, and local_cxx/local_cyy are negative with q ~0.30. These isolated marginals do not support a coordinate direction on their own.

Curve support is restricted: only 24 of 200 continuous features pass the selection rule (|integrated z| >= 0.1, batch direction fraction >= 0.857, q < 0.05) with a fidelity rule of relative RMSE <= 0.35 and zero strong sign conflicts. The curve-fidelity audit is delivered as a container summary only, so per-feature sign changes and rate changes are not yet read.

hypotheses.falsifier: no increase in batch-consistent excess fixed-RMS contrast relative to the static rule, or a sign conflict in the fitted contrast curve
hypotheses.observable: batch-consistent endpoint pointcloud contrast (compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A) across the 14 independent batches
hypotheses.scope: observed score times within the learning window [0.0,0.5], native endpoint VJP, no extra model forward
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned teacher-attention recipe that up-weights the observed-node contrast at later score times will produce a larger batch-consistent endpoint pointcloud contrast than the static constant rule, because the validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.

hypotheses.falsifier: joint pattern survival_enrichment_z not exceeding the best isolated marginal, or q remaining above the joint BH threshold
hypotheses.observable: survival_enrichment_z for the joint pattern versus the best isolated marginal, with BH q reported
hypotheses.statement: A joint landmark_00 soft-mass plus local-shape coordinate pattern will carry more consistent survival credit than any isolated landmark_00 marginal descriptor, because the isolated marginals are individually weak and near-zero.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit and the selection-vs-survival affinity comparison is unavailable.
The curve-fidelity audit is delivered as a container summary only; per-feature sign changes, fit fidelity and rate changes across the full observed support were not read.
Survival and increment tests are BH-adjusted over large families (400 and 600 tests); most individual effects do not survive joint correction.
Ancestral coverage is thin (349/700 nodes with <3 ancestors, 531/700 with <6), so survival credit is dominated by shallow-lineage nodes.
No covariance, intact-conformation or mode diagnostics were read, so coherent joint coordinate patterns versus isolated marginals cannot be fully adjudicated.
No population-contrast versus parent-child increment turnover residual was read, so within-path change versus changing cohort composition is not resolved.
